title: keyDoor
responsibility: Provide key-door collision mechanics and a complete branching game document for either dimension.

inputs.name: keyDoor.state
inputs.description: Game state snapshot that keyDoor reads for x, y, hasKey, doorOpen and choice; it is never mutated, and every other field is copied unchanged into the result. x and y are coerced with Number(), so a missing or non-numeric value makes the returned x or y NaN.

inputs.name: keyDoor.input
inputs.description: One tick of movement: input.x and input.y are added to state.x and state.y, the sums are rounded to two decimal places and clamped, so the deltas themselves are never limited. input.choice replaces state.choice unless it is null or undefined (an empty string does replace it), and input.interact is not read.

inputs.name: exampleDocument.dimension
inputs.description: Dimension of the courtyard view in the returned document, '2d' or '3d'; it is written unchanged to that view's dimension and defaults to '2d' when the argument is undefined. The function does not check the value at runtime, so only the Dimension type limits it.

outputs.name: keyDoor
outputs.description: A new object with every field of the input state, where x is state.x plus input.x, rounded to two decimal places and clamped to 0 to 10 (and capped at 3 while both doorOpen and hasKey are falsy); y is state.y plus input.y, rounded and clamped to -3 to 3; choice is input.choice unless that is null or undefined, in which case it is state.choice. hasKey and doorOpen are copied, never set, and the input snapshot is not mutated.

outputs.name: exampleDocument
outputs.description: A version 1 document with one 'movement' mechanic (inputs x, y and choice; events key-collected and door-opened) and one 'courtyard' view whose dimension is the dimension argument. That view holds four checkpoints: 'key' at x 0, y 80; 'door' at x 270, y 80, requiring 'key'; and the branch checkpoints 'garden' at x 540, y 0 and 'vault' at x 540, y 180, each requiring 'door'.

mechanics.title: Movement and collision
mechanics.description: Move independently from the view. Collect the key before passing the door.

views.title: The courtyard
views.style: Lush illustrated garden, warm stone, soft sunlight. Preserve the player, key and door positions.

checkpoints.title: Collect the key
checkpoints.description: When the player reaches the key, add it to inventory.

checkpoints.title: Unlock the door
checkpoints.description: The key unlocks the door. Reveal two possible destinations.

checkpoints.title: Enter the garden
checkpoints.description: Choosing the garden ends the journey in the sunlight.

checkpoints.title: Explore the vault
checkpoints.description: Choosing the vault reveals the hidden treasure.
